correctness.rationale: For every q,n>=2, the earliest greedy embedding makes each distinct deletion descendant correspond to one canonical pair. Writing S=#nonzero adjacent differences, K=#zero-runs, E=#ABA inversions yields B=binom(S+1,2)+K-E, including n=2 constant input. Nonzero increments in each run have q-1 first choices; succeeding nonzero increments have one reversal and q-2 nonreversal choices. Counting alternating runs proves the stated polynomial, with negative powers canceled by B>=1. Independent Bernoulli change indicators and binomial reversal flags yield the exact mean and variance. I independently reconstructed this enumerator and compared it to actual distinct descendants and to the alternate fully equivalent formula in record 0, for 21 exhaustive (q,n) cases, and symbolically verified both given variance formulas agree; these finite checks support the written all-parameter proof.
